title: Bulbacraft Official Cobblemon
description: The official modpack for the Bulbacraft Cobblemon server — a feature-rich Pokémon experience with custom spawns, gyms, events, cosmetics and more.
body:
BulbaCraft | Cobblemon Server
BulbaCraft is a Pokémon-themed Cobblemon server running on Fabric 1.21.1, built around exploration, collection, and community.
Catch, train, and battle Pokémon across a rich world featuring custom legendary and paradox spawns, shiny hunting mechanics, and a fully fleshed-out progression system. Whether you're hunting Ultra Beasts in specific biomes, chasing shiny odds with catch combos, or working your way through our gym leader challenges, there's always something to work towards.
Features

🌟 Custom legendary & paradox spawn conditions with unique biome and time requirements
🐾 Shoulder mounts for 250+ Pokémon
🏆 Gym leaders with competitive teams across 18 types
📜 Battlepass system with 100+ levels of rewards
💼 Jobs system with 200 levels and real in-game rewards
🎁 Crate system with shiny, legendary and cosmetic keys
✨ Premium cosmetics including hats, player aspects and Pokémon aspects
🎉 Active Event Days with shiny boosts, XP multipliers, giveaways and more
💬 Friendly and welcoming community

Join Us
Built for both casual players and dedicated Pokémon fans, BulbaCraft offers a polished, feature-rich experience unlike any other Cobblemon server.
IP: play.bulbacraft.com
